prima_materia_raw: A poisoned communal drink is used as a trial.
vectors_raw: The drink may function as a test of surrender.

symbols.name: Chalice of Negation
symbols.literal: A cup containing a dangerous drink.
symbols.lv_hook: The old Order could use such a cup during initiation.

rituals.name: Poisoned Sacrament
rituals.description: Members might unknowingly ingest minute doses during a communal rite.

scene_hooks.hook_text_raw: A novice might discover a hidden herbarium containing the ingredients.

psych_pathology_raw: Submission may be reinforced by uncertainty about the dose.
atmospherics_raw: Bitter resin, cold metal, low lamplight.
